title: November 19,2025
content_text:
November 19,2025
After the National Day holiday I was fully focused on preparing for the November 2 release. Once the release was done, I spent my time fixing bugs and implementing new features. 
Today is November 19, and the intense work period is drawing to a close — my personal time and energy are returning, and I need to launch a sprint toward my personal goals. 
Based on yesterday’s analysis, my two main priorities right now are: improving my English, and exploring and putting into practice a side hustle. 
Next, I need to think carefully and break these priorities down into concrete action steps.
